requestSchema.label: Model ID
requestSchema.description: Model identifier. Bare IDs (claude-opus-5) and provider-prefixed IDs (anthropic/claude-opus-5) both work.

descriptionI18n.ko: 모델 ID. 무접두(claude-opus-5)와 공급자 접두(anthropic/claude-opus-5) 모두 사용 가능합니다.

limits.notes: Model-dependent aggregator. Context and output token limits vary by selected model and routed provider, so PocketRisu uses a number input instead of a fixed-limit slider.

requestSchema.label: Reasoning Effort
requestSchema.description: Reasoning depth for thinking models. 'none' disables thinking.

descriptionI18n.ko: 추론(사고) 강도. thinking 모델에 적용 (none은 비활성).

limits.notes: Model-dependent provider. Context and output token limits vary by selected model or deployment, so PocketRisu uses a number input instead of a fixed-limit slider.

requestSchema.label: API Key
requestSchema.description: NeuralWatt API key (created under API Keys & Allowances).

descriptionI18n.ko: NeuralWatt API 키 (API Keys & Allowances에서 발급).

requestSchema.label: Reasoning Effort
requestSchema.description: Reasoning depth. Applies to GLM thinking models on NeuralWatt; 'none' disables thinking. Kimi/Qwen expose thinking on/off via separate '-fast' model IDs instead of this knob.

descriptionI18n.ko: 추론(사고) 강도. NeuralWatt의 GLM thinking 모델에 적용 (none은 비활성). Kimi/Qwen은 이 노브 대신 '-fast' 모델 ID로 thinking on/off를 구분.

limits.notes: Model-dependent provider. NeuralWatt's /v1/models exposes per-model context length but reports max_output_tokens as null, so PocketRisu uses a number input for Max Tokens instead of a fixed-limit slider.

requestSchema.label: Model ID
requestSchema.description: Cloud-hosted model. Local Ollama cloud models commonly use the :cloud suffix (e.g. gpt-oss:120b-cloud), while direct ollama.com API examples may use the bare model name (e.g. gpt-oss:120b). See https://ollama.com/search?c=cloud for the current list.

descriptionI18n.ko: 클라우드 호스팅 모델. 로컬 Ollama의 클라우드 모델은 보통 :cloud 접미사를 사용하지만(예: gpt-oss:120b-cloud), ollama.com 직접 API 예시는 접미사 없는 모델명도 사용합니다(예: gpt-oss:120b). 최신 목록은 https://ollama.com/search?c=cloud 참조.

requestSchema.label: Reasoning Effort
requestSchema.description: Reasoning depth for thinking models (gpt-oss, etc.). 'none' disables thinking.

descriptionI18n.ko: 추론(사고) 강도. gpt-oss 등 thinking 모델에 적용 (none은 비활성).

limits.notes: Model-dependent provider. Context and output token limits vary by selected model or deployment, so PocketRisu uses a number input instead of a fixed-limit slider.

requestSchema.label: Reasoning Effort
requestSchema.description: Forward reasoning hints to compatible models.

requestSchema.label: Transforms
requestSchema.description: Content transforms (e.g. `middle-out` to compact long contexts).

descriptionI18n.ko: 공급자 라우팅 설정 (order, ignore, allow_fallbacks 등).

limits.notes: Model-dependent provider. Context and output token limits vary by selected model or deployment, so PocketRisu uses a number input instead of a fixed-limit slider.

requestSchema.label: Reasoning Effort
requestSchema.description: Reasoning depth. The gateway maps this to each model's native thinking config (e.g. Gemini thinkingLevel/thinkingBudget, OpenAI reasoning effort).

descriptionI18n.ko: 추론(사고) 강도. 게이트웨이가 모델별 thinking 설정(Gemini thinkingLevel/thinkingBudget, OpenAI reasoning effort 등)으로 변환합니다.

limits.notes: Model-dependent provider. Context and output token limits vary by selected model or deployment, so PocketRisu uses a number input instead of a fixed-limit slider.

requestSchema.label: Service Account JSON
requestSchema.description: Full Service Account JSON for OAuth token exchange. Needs the Vertex AI User role on the project.

descriptionI18n.ko: OAuth 토큰 교환용 Service Account 전체 JSON. 해당 프로젝트에 Vertex AI 사용자 역할이 필요해요.

requestSchema.label: Location
requestSchema.description: Vertex AI region (e.g. us-central1, global). Defaults to global when left blank.

descriptionI18n.ko: Vertex AI 리전 (예: us-central1, global). 비워두면 global이 됩니다.

requestSchema.label: Project ID
requestSchema.description: Google Cloud project id. Leave blank to use the project_id from the Service Account JSON.

descriptionI18n.ko: Google Cloud 프로젝트 ID. 비워두면 Service Account JSON의 project_id를 사용합니다.

requestSchema.label: Endpoint URL (override)
requestSchema.description: Advanced: full base URL up to '.../publishers/google/models'. Leave blank to assemble it from Location and Project ID. When set, this overrides both. The model name is appended automatically.

descriptionI18n.ko: 고급: '.../publishers/google/models'까지의 전체 base URL. 비워두면 Location·Project ID로 자동 조립해요. 입력하면 그 둘보다 우선합니다. 모델 이름은 자동으로 붙어요.

requestSchema.label: Model ID
requestSchema.description: Gemini model id used on the Vertex URL path (publishers/google/models/{id}). Use the bare Gemini id without the 'google/' prefix. Leave blank to use the profile's model.

descriptionI18n.ko: Vertex URL 경로(publishers/google/models/{id})에 쓰이는 Gemini 모델 ID. 'google/' 접두사 없는 bare ID를 입력하세요. 비워두면 프로필의 모델을 사용합니다.

requestSchema.label: Shared Request Type
requestSchema.description: Vertex shared-quota processing tier. Flex is ~50% cheaper but higher-latency; Priority is premium pricing with consistent low latency. Both work only on the global endpoint and select Gemini models (Gemini 2.5 is not supported). Default is standard pay-as-you-go — pick Flex/Priority to opt in.

descriptionI18n.ko: Vertex 공유 할당량 처리 등급. Flex는 약 50% 저렴하지만 지연이 높고, Priority는 프리미엄 과금에 일관된 저지연이에요. 둘 다 글로벌 엔드포인트와 일부 Gemini 모델에서만 동작해요(Gemini 2.5는 미지원). 기본값은 standard 종량제 — Flex/Priority는 선택 시에만 적용돼요.
